fields.Name: T199 - Database Designer New Entity Wizard Opens
fields.Description: Exercises the create-entity wizard launch (ShowCreateWizard slide-panel → database-create-wizard step indicator + step-basics form) — a bespoke multi-step schema-authoring UI, not the generic entity create form.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the Database Designer. Wait for it to load (10-30s possible — wait, don't navigate away). Click the '+ New Entity' button (top-right of the Database Designer header). Success is that a slide-over panel titled 'New Entity' opens, showing a multi-step wizard: a step indicator (steps such as Basics, Fields, Relationships, Review) and the first 'Basics' step form with an 'Entity Name' input (required), a 'Table Name' input, a 'Schema' selector, and a 'Description' textarea, plus a live preview pane on the right. Seeing the wizard open with the Basics form render is success — you do NOT need to actually create an entity. You may close/cancel the wizard afterward.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking '+ New Entity' opens a 'New Entity' slide-over wizard with a step indicator
The Basics step renders its form fields (Entity Name, Table Name, Schema, Description) alongside a preview pane
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
